name: V3 deterministic actual-scheduler economy simulation (30 days)
description: Advances due registered server cron handlers through the deterministic QA clock. Captures daily balances, bank and corporation transaction totals by type, planetary and port stocks, population, remainders, reward counts and invariants. No gameplay rates are modified.

tests.name: Authenticate isolated SysOp clock operator
Seed a bounded populated planet for actual scheduler production

data.sql: UPDATE planets SET population=1000,population_type='COLONIST',colonists_unassigned=0,colonists_ore=1000,colonists_org=0,colonists_eq=0,colonists_weapons=0,ore_production_remainder=0,production_last_tick=-1 WHERE planet_id=900;

tests.name: Configure production using the authoritative planet-class worker rule

data.sql: UPDATE planet_production SET base_prod_rate=0,base_cons_rate=0,workers_per_unit=100 WHERE planet_type_id=(SELECT type FROM planets WHERE planet_id=900) AND commodity_code='ORE';

tests.name: Initialize controlled planetary ORE storage and activity ledger

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES(900,'ORE',0,10000,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET quantity=0,max_capacity=10000,production_rate=0;

tests.name: Initialize authoritative planetary inventory

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES('planet',900,'ORE',0,0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=0;

tests.name: Clear prior activity for the controlled planetary producer

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id=900;

tests.name: Prepare an Orion corporation for scheduled NPC activity

data.sql: INSERT INTO corporations(name,owner_id,tag,ship_personality) VALUES ('EXC09 Orion Scheduler QA',107,'ORION','balanced'),('EXC09 Ledger QA',107,'EXC09','balanced') ON CONFLICT (upper(tag)) WHERE tag IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Seed a deterministic NPC actor for actual scheduled movement

data.sql: WITH home AS (SELECT center_sector FROM clusters WHERE role='ORION' LIMIT 1), npc AS (INSERT INTO players(name,passwd,sector_id,credits,type,is_npc,commission_id) SELECT 'EXC09 Orion scheduler actor','$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=3,p=1$m9e+qkJe5du1SC25jkIB0A$fd2PpiLEjU5d2AXlAf1nznGko41GPU7Z2jxX3gX0QZE',center_sector,100000,2,TRUE,1 FROM home RETURNING player_id), member AS (INSERT INTO corp_members(corporation_id,player_id,role) SELECT c.corporation_id,n.player_id,'Officer' FROM corporations c CROSS JOIN npc n WHERE c.tag='ORION' RETURNING player_id), ship AS (INSERT INTO ships(name,type_id,sector_id,holds,fighters,shields,hull,personality,destroyed) SELECT 'EXC09 Orion scheduler hull',2,center_sector,10,100,0,100,'balanced',FALSE FROM home RETURNING ship_id) INSERT INTO ship_ownership(ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) SELECT s.ship_id,n.player_id,1,TRUE FROM ship s CROSS JOIN npc n;

tests.name: Initialize the corporation treasury measured by daily snapshots

data.sql: INSERT INTO corp_accounts(corp_id,currency,balance) SELECT corporation_id,'CRD',CASE WHEN tag='ORION' THEN 250000 ELSE 125000 END FROM corporations WHERE tag IN ('ORION','EXC09') ON CONFLICT (corp_id) DO UPDATE SET balance=EXCLUDED.balance;

tests.name: Verify the ordinary-player and corporation populations for the 30-day world

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)>=2 FROM players WHERE is_npc IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)>=2 FROM corp_accounts)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)>=2 FROM ports)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)>=2 FROM planets)::int;

tests.name: Move enabled deadlines into future before activating simulated time

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 hour' WHERE enabled=TRUE;

tests.name: Enable test-only deterministic scheduler switch

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value,type='int';
